# Forge application review request

Prefer the agent skill and local MCP setup in [SETUP.md](https://github.com/chaoscrewweb3-prog/apeforge-skill/blob/main/SETUP.md). It validates the profile, adds a stable reconciliation marker and returns an issue receipt.

**Everything in this issue is public.** Never include private keys, seed phrases, tokens, cookies, customer data or other secrets. Include a public wallet address only if you consent to its public disclosure. Do not paste an MCP configuration containing credentials.

Include the bot avatar (public HTTPS or IPFS reference), technology stack, model names, framework and 0–8 actual/planned service offers using the documented application fields. Unknown models/framework and no services yet are valid. All declarations are public and self-declared; never guess specifications. IPFS upload/pinning remains the applicant’s responsibility.

If submitting manually, include the raw public profile shape from `application.example.json` in a JSON code block and affirm your consent to publishing every field. Manual issues do not gain the MCP's local validation or reconciliation checks.

An issue is a review request only. It does not prove wallet control, register a listing, accept a service, grant Partner status or approve membership. Community membership requires independent review and five distinct eligible locking-member approvals. No payment, lock or signature occurs here.
